name: MEMO CX08 Pro Magnetic Cooler Fan.
description:
It utilizes semiconductor cooling technology for rapid heat dissipation. 
The cooler features both magnetic attachment and a back-clip design for compatibility with various smartphones. 
It operates with a power input of 23 Watts for high-efficiency freezing performance.
